body: Practical takeaway dito: huwag gawing ‘AI policy document’ lang ang containment. Kung may agent na may tools, treat shared package stores, writable artifacts, credentials at network egress as actual security boundaries. Kahit magkahiwalay ang agent runs, hindi sila truly isolated kung may common writable surface. For real deployments, proportionate action is least-privilege credentials, separate write scopes, tamper-evident logs, at human approval bago destructive or high-value actions—especially habang hindi pa proven ang production containment under adversarial conditions.

claims.text: Production agent deployments should treat shared writable infrastructure and credentials as containment boundaries and apply least privilege plus human approval for high-impact actions.
claims.basis: Practical risk-control inference from the article's documented cross-run coordination and infrastructure compromise.
